item.title: Increased HTTP Errors in GIG (Rio de Janeiro)
item.description: Sep 17, 14:00 UTCResolved - Cloudflare is aware that there was an increased level of HTTP errors in the GIG (Rio de Janeiro) datacenter, between 14:00 and 14:30 UTC. This has since recovered and normal operations have resumed.

item.title: China Industrial Robots Shift Toward Domestic Capability Structure
item.description: Domestic industrial-robot brands now claim about 55% of China shipments, with Estun leading volume and Inovance strong in SCARA and servos, while high-end auto and semiconductor process software remain harder to displace.

item.title: Stable AI and Tsinghua Release LimiX-2 Structured-Data Foundation Model
item.description: Stable AI and Tsinghua University released LimiX-2, a 400M structured-data foundation model using Contextual Mechanism Networks, claiming top Elo scores of 1935/1432/1506 on TabArena, BCCO, and TALENT.

item.title: Light Origins Open-Sources LightNav-0 Generalist Navigation Brain
item.description: Light Origins open-sourced LightNav-0, a Qwen3-VL-4B navigation model trained via Real2Sim2Real on 2,000+ scenes and 4,000+ hours of VLA data, leading 10 monocular navigation benches with zero-shot body transfer.

item.title: Scalabot HERON-CRA Adds Context Memory and RL Engine for Embodied Control
item.description: Songyan Dynamics' Scalabot brand released HERON-CRA, pairing 4D Context Expert memory, a plug-in RL Engine, and cross-embodiment pretraining, with sock-folding success rising from 38.5% to 97.8%.

item.title: Huawei Unveils Ascend 960 SuperPoD With Near-Package Optics at Connect 2026
item.description: At Huawei Connect 2026, Huawei introduced the Ascend 960 SuperPoD with near-package optics, UnifiedBus and Hi-ONE, targeting ~4,096 cards per node and a pulled-forward 2027 ship window.
